title: trunk/69908d8e41ec875bbbf4729edebbccce2ee7ab37: [dynamo] Raise TypeError for len() of a 0-d tensor (#203515)
excerpt: Linked issue or supporting maintainer Fixes #202895 Supported by @rtimpe BC-breaking? No Summary Calling len() on a 0-dimensional tensor under torch.compile previously leaked an internal IndexError during Dynamo tracing instead of matching PyTorch eager's TypeError . This prevented standard try...except TypeError exception handling in user code and caused compilation to fail. Root Cause TensorVariable.sq_length_impl ( torch/_dynamo/variables/tensor.py ) unconditionally traced size(0) . For 0-d tensors, _method_size_stride indexed an empty size tuple, causing an internal IndexError during tracing. Fix Updated TensorVariable.sq_length_impl to check ndim . When ndim is known to be 0 , Dynamo now explicitly raises TypeError("len() of a 0-d tensor") to match eager Tensor.__len__ . If ndim is unknown, existing behavior is preserved. Test Plan Added unit tests to TestTensorLen in test/dynamo/test_len_protocol.py covering len() , __len__ , and Tensor.__len__ on 0-d tensors, try/except handling with and without fullgraph=True , and uncaught error paths. python test/dynamo/test_len_protocol.py -k TestTensorLen Pull Request resolved: #203515 Approved by: https://github.com/rtimpe
